review:
Donny and Danny brings the Cash Kings together. Donny symbols build LootLines: three or more on a winning payline, or a mix with Danny, each pick a value from the Cash Board, and the line pays their combined total. Danny symbols expand upward into Dollar-Reels after regular wins are paid.

Every position on a Dollar-Reel shows a multiplier and can join a LootLine, so the two characters make each other stronger. In the Make It Reign and Cash Kings Forever bonuses, Booster symbols push values higher. The maximum is 12,500x, matching Danny Dollar.
